d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains how Elon Musk has publicly backed a growing campaign to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia’s chief executive, writing on X that he is signing an open letter urging the AI chipmaker’s board to reconsider its leadership shake-up. The ‘Stand With Jensen’ petition—which has attracted tens of thousands of signatures from self-reported Nvidia employees, shareholders, and tech leaders—demands due process, a fair hearing, and Huang’s immediate reinstatement while an independent investigation unfolds.
